usedFor: Shopify holds orders and Docmaker builds documents, so “Order Cancelled” can produce a file through “Create PDF From Docx Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create PDF From Docx Template” in Docmaker
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order can fill a Docx template with its data and return a merged PDF.

watchOut: “Create PDF From Docx Template” returns the file in its response, so add a step that stores or sends it.
